system.description: This peach-colored, almond-shaped crystal enables its bearer to change gender at will. This transformation is instantaneous and can be made as a reflexive action. The transformation leaves the character moderately recognizable. The stone does not significantly alter the character's size or features: A tall, muscular man, for instance, becomes a tall, muscular woman. Any character who knows the bearer can recognize her with a successful (Perception + Awareness) roll. Factors that may increase the roll's difficulty include radically different clothing, a hidden face or not having seen the transgendered character in a long time.
